title: Unit-normalized proper and open arrows on strict towers
statement: On the strict constant-coefficient module tower categories [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations] with exact open extension [def-cbc-strict-tower-open-extension], define the inverse cartesian open comparison by transposing the pullback of the open-adjunction unit. It is invertible for a cartesian square; its inverse is beta, whose evaluation at finite constant coefficients is the normalized finite open comparison [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change]. For a commutative square with quasi-compact open horizontal maps and proper vertical maps [def-weil-proper-morphism], form its canonical lift to the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]; this lift is open and closed. The canonical open-extension-to-direct-image map is the counit mate of the inverse open unit, and it is invertible on a clopen immersion. Define the clopen projection pi by the direct-image adjunction unit followed by this inverse. Define alpha by cartesian beta, this pi and the normalized composition isomorphisms. Define gamma as the proper-adjunction mate of alpha, and define the usual pullback/direct-image exchange map as the mate of the canonical inverse-image square isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate].

source.place: Tags 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open), 0F7C (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose), 0F7D (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose-horizontal), 0F7F (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change), open-immersion cases; derived strict-tower and pro-etale refinement of these statements, with the mate construction of sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change) and proetale.tex Tag 09AE (definition-extension-zero). The source states the etale result; the tower realization, finite-evaluation normalization and pro-etale extension are additional assertions to be proved, not quotations from the source.; strict-tower proof steps introducing these operations.

proof.text: Naturality of betaInvApp is the naturality square transported by the open adjunction Hom equivalence. Apply Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_square to the natural transformation obtained by whiskering the open unit and the inverse squareG. This proves betaInvApp_naturality without a separate geometric base-change assertion.

For an arbitrary commutative B, restrict scalars along the sheafification unit from the constant ring presheaf. This gives a fully faithful functor from modules over the constant ring sheaf to sheaves of fixed B-modules: local injectivity and local surjectivity of the scalar unit give full faithfulness of scalar restriction, and the sheaf condition is detected on underlying additive groups. To show essential surjectivity, construct a constant-presheaf module from a fixed B-module sheaf, extend scalars and sheafify it; the unit on its underlying additive sheaf is an isomorphism. Direct image commutes with this equivalence sectionwise, since the ring map sends each constant scalar to the same constant scalar. Uniqueness of left adjoints supplies pullback and open-extension comparisons. Transport the already proved ordinary pro-etale openImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso through these equivalences, obtaining moduleOpenSquare without a finiteness hypothesis on B.

Whisker moduleOpenSquare over the tower index and apply exact localization to get J_j G_g isomorphic to G_a J_jprime. The open unit is invertible by jAdj_unit_isIso, hence J_jprime is fully faithful. Its counit is invertible on the object G_g J_j M, which lies in its essential image by this isomorphism. The specified betaInvApp is the counit composed with J_jprime applied to the pulled-back invertible unit and the square isomorphism. Thus every component of the specified betaInv is invertible, proving betaInv_isIso.

For the finite-evaluation normalization, first prove the unit formula for the specified exact/right-derived open adjunction from derivedη_fac_app and rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac. Localization preserves mates with this formula: verify it on homotopy-category images using the factorization isomorphisms and the degreewise unit equation, then extend by essential surjectivity. The explicit moduleSquareG_eq formula shows that squareG is precisely the exact-localization square of the whiskered moduleSquareG. Consequently betaInv is exactly the localized whiskering of singleBetaInv. Finally the composition associativity and naturality laws for mapDerivedCategoryCompIso show that level evaluation preserves each localized square. Apply this to the inverse of singleBetaInv, and identify the evaluation isomorphisms with the specified evalJ and evalG. This proves beta_evaluation for the particular maps, rather than merely identifying their source and target functors.

Let s be the canonical pullback lift. Its composite with the first projection is k, so IsOpenImmersion.of_comp proves that s is open. Its composite with the second projection is r, and that projection is separated because it is a base change of the proper map p. IsProper.of_comp therefore makes s proper. Its image is closed by properness, and IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion turns the open immersion with closed image into a closed immersion. This proves squareLift_clopen, including the empty-open case.

The ordinary pro-etale open-extension adjunction has invertible unit by the proved open-immersion adjunction triple and the invertible restriction/direct-image counit. Hence ordinary open extension is fully faithful. The fixedOpen comparison transports this full faithfulness to moduleJ composed with fixedRestriction on the target. Since fixedRestriction is faithful, moduleJ is fully faithful, and therefore the particular moduleJAdj unit is invertible. This replaces the direct localized-site argument with the already constructed fixed-coefficient equivalence.

Whisker the module open adjunction by the strict tower index. Its unit is pointwise invertible, so it is a natural isomorphism. Exact localization maps this unit isomorphism and the composition and identity functor isomorphisms to an isomorphism J composed with G to the identity. Adjunction.isIso_unit_of_iso proves invertibility of the unit of the specified jAdj, without changing its normalization. This completes jAdj_unit_isIso.

For a clopen immersion, the proved ordinary pro-etale isIso_openImmersionLowerShriekToLowerStar_of_isClosed_range gives an isomorphism between open extension and direct image on fixed B-module sheaves. Transport it through the arbitrary-B scalar equivalence to obtain moduleClopenIso. Thus tower direct image is exact and its total right derived functor R is isomorphic to J. In particular R is fully faithful. The pullback/direct-image adjunction unit is invertible on J M because J M lies in the essential image of R. The specified openToR component is that unit followed by R of the inverse open unit, with identity associators and unitors, so is invertible. Retain pi, alpha, gamma and exchange with precisely their existing canonical definitions.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09AE and the already proved ordinary pro-etale open-base-change and clopen-comparison theorems, transported through restriction along the constant-ring sheafification unit for arbitrary B. Exact localization of units and mates proves the specified finite evaluation equality. Y9 stage 3 completes betaInv_isIso, beta_evaluation and openToR_isIso, retaining the J9 proofs of naturality and the clopen lift, and shortening the open-unit proof using the same coefficient equivalence. Tags 01W6 and 01IQ supply the geometric lift argument.
